hero.title: Premium industrial insulation.
hero.text: High-performance insulation materials and industrial products for piping, HVAC, refrigeration, equipment and industrial applications.

products.name: PUF Pipe Sections
products.shortDescription: Pre-formed rigid polyurethane foam sections for chilled, hot water and process piping.
products.description: PUF pipe sections are pre-formed rigid polyurethane foam insulation supplied in half-shell or full-round form to fit standard pipe sizes. The closed-cell structure of polyurethane foam makes these sections a common choice for chilled water, hot water and process piping where controlling heat gain, heat loss and surface condensation matters. Sections are fitted around the pipe, secured, and typically finished with a vapour barrier and cladding.
features: Pre-formed to fit standard pipe sizes
Quick to fit and secure on site
Suitable for use with foil facing and metal cladding
options: Available pipe sizes, wall thicknesses and lengths — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: PUF Slabs/Sheets
products.shortDescription: Rigid polyurethane foam slabs and sheets for equipment, tanks and duct insulation.
products.description: PUF slabs and sheets are flat rigid polyurethane foam boards that can be cut and fitted to flat or large-radius surfaces. They are used to insulate equipment, tanks, vessels and ducting where a rigid closed-cell insulation is required. Sheets are fixed with adhesive or pins and finished with facing, tape and cladding as the application requires.
features: Flat rigid boards, easy to cut on site
Can be fixed with adhesive or insulation pins
options: Available sheet sizes and thicknesses — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: PIR Pipe Sections
products.shortDescription: Pre-formed polyisocyanurate foam sections for high-temperature industrial piping.
products.description: PIR pipe sections are pre-formed polyisocyanurate foam insulation for industrial pipework. PIR is a rigid closed-cell foam related to polyurethane and is commonly specified for industrial piping that runs at higher service temperatures than standard PUF applications, and for cold service lines. Sections are supplied in half-shell form for standard pipe sizes and finished with vapour barrier and cladding.
features: Used for both hot and cold service piping
options: Available pipe sizes and thicknesses — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: PIR/PUR Sheets
products.shortDescription: Rigid PIR and PUR foam sheets for equipment and cold insulation.
products.description: PIR/PUR sheets are flat rigid foam boards available in polyisocyanurate (PIR) or polyurethane (PUR) grades. They are used for equipment and cold insulation on vessels, tanks, cold rooms and flat surfaces. The boards are cut to suit, fixed with adhesive or pins and completed with a facing or cladding system.
features: Available as PIR or PUR grade
Rigid flat boards for equipment surfaces
Easy to cut, fix and finish
options: Grades, sheet sizes and thicknesses — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Rockwool Pipe Sections
products.shortDescription: Pre-formed mineral wool sections for high-temperature pipes.
products.description: Rockwool pipe sections are pre-formed mineral wool insulation moulded to fit standard pipe sizes. Mineral wool is widely used on high-temperature pipework such as steam, hot process lines and boiler connections. Sections are secured with binding wire or bands and protected with metal cladding.
features: Mineral wool construction for hot service
Pre-formed sections for standard pipe sizes
Finishes with GI or aluminium cladding
options: Available pipe sizes, densities and thicknesses — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Rockwool Slabs
products.shortDescription: Mineral wool slabs for boilers, tanks, ducts and equipment.
products.description: Rockwool slabs are semi-rigid mineral wool boards for insulating flat and curved surfaces on boilers, tanks, ducts and industrial equipment. They are fixed with insulation pins or wire mesh and covered with cladding. Mineral wool is a common choice where the insulated surface runs hot.
options: Available slab sizes, densities and thicknesses — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Glass Wool Rolls
products.shortDescription: Flexible glass wool rolls for HVAC ducts and buildings.
products.description: Glass wool rolls are flexible fibrous insulation supplied in roll form, commonly used for HVAC duct wrapping and building thermal and acoustic insulation. Rolls are wrapped around ducts, fixed with pins or adhesive, and the joints sealed with foil tape to complete the vapour barrier.
options: Roll sizes, thicknesses and facings — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Glass Wool Pipe Sections
products.shortDescription: Pre-formed glass wool sections for HVAC and refrigeration piping.
products.description: Glass wool pipe sections are pre-formed fibrous insulation moulded to fit standard pipe sizes, used on HVAC and refrigeration piping. Sections are typically supplied with a foil facing that acts as a vapour barrier, and are fitted and taped at the joints.
options: Pipe sizes, thicknesses and facings — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: NBR/EPDM Rubber Insulation
products.shortDescription: Flexible closed-cell rubber insulation for chilled water and refrigeration lines.
products.description: NBR/EPDM rubber insulation is a flexible closed-cell elastomeric foam supplied as tubes and sheets. It is a standard choice for chilled water and refrigeration lines because the closed-cell structure helps control condensation on cold surfaces without a separate vapour barrier. Joints and seams are bonded with insulation adhesive.
options: Tube sizes, sheet sizes and thicknesses — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: XLPE Insulation
products.shortDescription: Closed-cell cross-linked polyethylene insulation for HVAC and plumbing pipes.
products.description: XLPE insulation is a closed-cell cross-linked polyethylene foam supplied as tubes, sheets and rolls. It is used on HVAC and plumbing pipes where a light, flexible closed-cell insulation is required. XLPE can be supplied plain or with a foil facing, and joints are sealed with tape or adhesive.
features: Available as tubes, sheets and rolls
Simple to cut and seal on site
options: Sizes, thicknesses and facings — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Aerogel Insulation
products.shortDescription: Thin flexible aerogel blanket for high-performance industrial insulation.
products.description: Aerogel insulation is a flexible blanket in which aerogel is held in a fibrous carrier. It is used for high-performance industrial insulation where space around the pipe or equipment is limited, or where a thin insulation layer is preferred. The blanket is cut, wrapped, secured with wire or tape and clad in the normal way.
features: Works with standard cladding and finishing
options: Blanket thicknesses and roll sizes — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Aluminium Cladding Sheets
products.shortDescription: Aluminium sheet cladding for weather protection over insulation.
products.description: Aluminium cladding sheets are the outer metal jacket fitted over pipe, tank and equipment insulation. They protect the insulation from weather, moisture and mechanical damage and give the installation a clean, durable finish. Sheets are rolled or formed to suit the pipe or surface and fixed with screws or bands, with joints sealed where required.
features: Formed to suit pipes, tanks and equipment
Protects insulation from weather and damage
Fixed with screws, rivets or bands
options: Sheet gauges, sizes and finishes — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Aluminium Foil
products.shortDescription: Aluminium foil for vapour barrier and facing on insulation.
products.description: Aluminium foil is used as a vapour barrier and facing layer over insulation on ducts, pipes and equipment. It limits moisture movement into the insulation and provides a reflective, cleanable surface. Foil is applied over the insulation and joints are sealed with foil tape.
features: Applied over pipes, ducts and equipment
options: Foil thicknesses, widths and reinforcement — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: GI Cladding Sheets
products.shortDescription: Galvanised steel cladding for industrial insulation protection.
products.description: GI cladding sheets are galvanised steel jackets fitted over industrial insulation on pipes, boilers, tanks and equipment. They provide robust mechanical and weather protection in industrial environments. Sheets are formed to the surface, fixed with screws or bands, and sealed at joints.
features: Formed to pipes, tanks and equipment
options: Sheet gauges and sizes — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Insulation Adhesive
products.shortDescription: Adhesive for fixing insulation materials to surfaces and bonding seams.
products.description: Insulation adhesive is used to fix insulation materials to pipes, ducts and equipment and to bond seams and joints on rubber and foam insulation. Selecting the correct adhesive for the insulation material and surface helps the installation stay in place and keeps joints closed.
applications: Fixing sheets to ducts and equipment
features: Seals seams on rubber and foam insulation
Supplied in tins for site use
Choose to suit the insulation material
options: Adhesive types and pack sizes — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Insulation Tape
products.shortDescription: Tape for sealing joints and completing vapour barriers.
products.description: Insulation tape is used to seal joints, seams and edges on insulation and foil facings so the vapour barrier stays continuous. Foil tapes are used with foil-faced products, while other tapes are used for finishing rubber and foam insulation.
options: Tape types, widths and roll lengths — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: SS/GI Binding Wire
products.shortDescription: Stainless steel and galvanised binding wire for securing insulation.
products.description: SS/GI binding wire is used to secure pipe sections, slabs and blankets in place before cladding is fitted. Stainless steel wire is selected where corrosion resistance or higher temperatures require it; galvanised wire is used for general insulation work.
options: Wire grades, gauges and coil weights — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Pipe Support Inserts
products.shortDescription: Load-bearing inserts that prevent insulation crushing at pipe supports.
products.description: Pipe support inserts are load-bearing insulation blocks fitted where an insulated pipe rests on a support, hanger or clamp. They carry the load of the pipe so the surrounding insulation is not compressed, keeping the insulation and vapour barrier intact at support points.
features: Made to suit pipe size and insulation thickness
options: Pipe sizes, insert lengths and thicknesses — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Insulation Fasteners/Pins
products.shortDescription: Pins, washers and fasteners for fixing insulation to equipment and ducts.
products.description: Insulation fasteners and pins are used to hold slabs, sheets and rolls against flat surfaces on equipment, tanks and ducts. Pins are fixed to the surface by welding or adhesive, the insulation is pressed over them and secured with washers.
features: Holds slabs and sheets on flat surfaces
options: Pin types, lengths and washer sizes — Contact EIC for available specifications.

products.name: Mastic/Sealant
products.shortDescription: Mastic and sealant for waterproofing and sealing insulation joints.
products.description: Mastic and sealant are applied to seal joints, terminations and penetrations on insulation and cladding systems. They stop water and moisture entering the insulation at the points where cladding meets flanges, valves, supports and end caps.
features: Applied at flanges, valves and end caps
options: Sealant types and pack sizes — Contact EIC for available specifications.
